detail.longDescription:
I’ve now managed to get the stream of my HiWatch Series, model HWI- T641H-Z
2.8-12 mm by accessing via browser to
rtsp://USERNAME:PASSWORD@192.168.30.50:554/Streaming/Channels/101. Working nice.
But on its own, very unusful unless I get storage and image detection going. So,
I need something like Frigate. I believe the Frigate docs suggest running in a
docker container installed on a VM. Very convienient as I have Proxmox
(installed on a optiples 7070 micropc with 32MB ram) running a VM on which i
have a few containers. The idea is to mount a “frigate” dataset created on my
Truenas server on Proxmox which is then mounted to the VM. Lots of layers but
hoping it should be ok. I heard that the Google Coral TPU is not sold anymore.
Is this going to be a problem for Frigate image recognition? Are there
alternatives to the Coral TPU?
